# The committed vector files and how each is recorded (see internal/vectors).
# Regenerate and compare: go run ./internal/cmd/vectors   (re-record: -write)
#
# dir | env | command (node's arguments) | outputs | inputs (globs from the root) | platform
#
# TZ is UTC unless env sets it; NODE_PATH is testdata/oracle-node's node_modules,
# or testdata/oracle-node-vl5's with MODULES=vl5.

internal/expr | - | testdata/gen_expr.mjs | > testdata/expr_utc.json.gz | - | any
internal/expr | TZ=America/New_York | testdata/gen_expr.mjs dates | > testdata/expr_ny.json.gz | - | any
internal/expr | - | testdata/gen_functions.mjs | > testdata/functions.json | - | any
internal/expr | - | testdata/gen_math.mjs | > testdata/math_bits.json.gz | - | darwin-arm64

internal/format | - | testdata/gen_number.mjs | > testdata/number.json.gz | - | any
internal/format | TZ=UTC | testdata/gen_time.mjs | > testdata/time_UTC.json.gz | - | any
internal/format | TZ=America/New_York | testdata/gen_time.mjs | > testdata/time_America_New_York.json.gz | - | any
internal/format | TZ=Europe/Amsterdam | testdata/gen_time.mjs | > testdata/time_Europe_Amsterdam.json.gz | - | any
internal/format | TZ=America/Sao_Paulo | testdata/gen_time.mjs | > testdata/time_America_Sao_Paulo.json.gz | - | any
internal/format | TZ=Asia/Kolkata | testdata/gen_time.mjs | > testdata/time_Asia_Kolkata.json.gz | - | any
internal/format | TZ=Australia/Lord_Howe | testdata/gen_time.mjs | > testdata/time_Australia_Lord_Howe.json.gz | - | any

internal/geo/testdata | - | gen_geo.mjs | files points.json.gz paths.json.gz fit.json.gz measures.json graticule.json.gz topo.json.gz digits.json angle.json geoms.json.gz random.json.gz | testdata/vega-datasets/data/* | darwin-arm64
internal/geo/testdata | - | gen_pipeline.mjs | files pipeline.json.gz | testdata/vega-datasets/data/* | any

internal/jssort | - | testdata/gen_sort.mjs | > testdata/sort.json.gz | - | any
internal/jsval | - | testdata/gen_numbers.js | > testdata/numbers.json | - | any

internal/vega | VEGA_DATA_DIRS=../../testdata/vega-datasets/data:../../testdata/data/data | gen_scenegraph.mjs $OUT glob:../../testdata/corpus/vega/*.vg.json glob:testdata/specs/*.vg.json | outdir testdata/scene json | testdata/corpus/vega/* internal/vega/testdata/specs/* testdata/vega-datasets/data/* testdata/data/data/* | any
internal/vega | WITH_SVG=1 VEGA_DATA_DIRS=../../testdata/vega-datasets/data:../../testdata/data/data | gen_scenegraph.mjs $OUT glob:../../testdata/corpus/vega/*.vg.json glob:testdata/specs/*.vg.json | outdir testdata/svg svg | testdata/corpus/vega/* internal/vega/testdata/specs/* testdata/vega-datasets/data/* testdata/data/data/* | any
